changes.name: SkyboundCoreMillion
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local function setup(p)
 local stats=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder");stats.Name="leaderstats";stats.Parent=p
 local coins=stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins") or Instance.new("IntValue");coins.Name="SkyCoins";coins.Parent=stats
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setup)
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do setup(p) end

changes.name: MillionOrbSystem
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local folder=workspace:WaitForChild("SkyboundMap"):WaitForChild("SkyCoins")
local busy={}
for _,coin in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
 if coin:IsA("BasePart") then
  coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
   local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
   if not player or busy[coin] then return end
   local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
   local c=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("SkyCoins")
   if not c then return end
   busy[coin]=true
   c.Value+=1000000
   coin.Transparency=1
   coin.CanTouch=false
   local l=coin:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
   if l then l.Enabled=false end
   task.delay(7,function()
    if coin.Parent then
     coin.Transparency=0
     coin.CanTouch=true
     if l then l.Enabled=true end
     busy[coin]=nil
    end
   end)
  end)
 end
end
